input.quote: 18.5 Upon the effective date of termination of participation of a Party, Schedules of this Agreement shall be appropriately modified. The remaining Parties to this Agreement shall assume the obligations, capital, operation, and maintenance interests of the Party terminating its participation in proportion to their interests assigned immediately preceding such effective date of termination, except for the continuing rights and obligations of the terminating Party as specified in Subparagraph 18.7 of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Paragraph 18 is the only end-of-term mechanic: 18.1-18.3 govern notice and decommissioning votes, 18.5 amends the Schedules and reallocates interests, 18.6 liquidates and distributes segment assets, and 18.7/32.6 preserve accrued third-party liabilities. None of these is transition assistance or a data return: asset realization distributes sale proceeds, it does not hand back a withdrawing Party's data or help it migrate. 18.4 only obliges the Parties to "negotiate a reasonable agreement" for continued terminal-station operation after the Initial Period, which is an agreement to agree, is limited to post-Initial-Period Terminal Party withdrawals, and carries no assistance duration or export deadline. Paragraph 31 confidentiality survives five years but requires no return or export of data, and the 9.2 record-keeping period binds the Supplier, not the Parties. The rule therefore has no usable clause, so we insert one at the fallback level (90 days of assistance, export within 30 days) as new Subparagraph 18.8. We deliberately did not volunteer the preferred six-month, machine-readable-format and certified-deletion terms.

proposal.summary: Insert new Subparagraph 18.8 requiring exit assistance and data export on expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 18 deals with schedule amendments and asset realization but gives us no exit help and no return of our data, so we have added a short Subparagraph 18.8 at our fallback position: ninety days of transition assistance and export of our data within thirty days of any expiry or termination.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, or upon the effective date of termination of a Party's participation in this Agreement, the other Parties shall provide that Party with reasonable transition assistance for a period of not less than ninety (90) days following such expiry or termination, and shall export and deliver to that Party, within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, all data and information belonging to, supplied by, or held or processed on behalf of that Party.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
